TEXT:
Parting with Hinata-chan and Tamaki-chan, I 
wandered around town looking for Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't see her anywhere.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hmm, it's summer vacation but... club activities are 
still ongoing, right?
Think I'll just pop in for a quick check.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
If you're looking for Gokou-san, she might be at the 
Game Center?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Probably.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
According to my sources, the winner of the Siscaly 
World Tournament showed up there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmmm.
The Siscaly World Tournament, huh?
The one Kuroneko participated in and lost?

Incidentally, Sena shouldn't know that Kuroneko is 
the famous "Matsudo Black Cat", though.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Gokou-san seems to like games too, so I won't be 
surprised if she's roaming the Game Center to 
challenge this skilled gamer.
Oh, I understand your logic there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
How about you? Wouldn't you like to play with that 
so-called skilled gamer who won a tournament?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I'm having more fun making games now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That so?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
If you find her, please tell her to show up for club 
activities.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
And let her know, "You're an important asset to our 
club".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I got it, I'll tell her.

...Sena and Kuroneko have become so close in such 
a short time.

As someone who's marginally involved in the 
beginning of their friendship, I was happy to see 
that.
